memberdef.name: DEF_RECURSIVE_LOCK
memberdef.initializer: DEF_RECURSIVE_LOCK_TYPE(name, lock_type); \ DEF_RECURSIVE_LOCK_INIT(name, lock_init) \ DEF_RECURSIVE_LOCK_RELEASE(name, lock_release, context_sel) \ DEF_RECURSIVE_LOCK_ACQUIRE(name, lock_acquire, context_sel) \ DEF_RECURSIVE_LOCK_TRYACQUIRE(name, tryacquire_sel, context_sel)

briefdescription.para: Defines a recursive lock type and functions to initialize, acquire, and release it.

parameterdescription.para: initialization function of the base lock

memberdef.name: DEF_RECURSIVE_LOCK_TYPE
memberdef.initializer: typedef struct name##_s { \ lock_type lock; \ vatomic32_t owner; \ vuint32_t count; \ } VSYNC_CACHEALIGN name##_t

briefdescription.para: Defines struct name_s and name_t as recursive lock embedding lock_type.
Invalid CPU ID used to represent a released lock.
Initializer of the recursive and the base lock.

memberdef.name: DEF_RECURSIVE_LOCK_INIT
memberdef.initializer: static inline void name##_init(name##_t *l) \ { \ lock_init(&l->lock); \ vatomic32_init(&l->owner, RECURSIVE_LOCK_NOCPU); \ l->count = 0; \ }

briefdescription.para: Defines the acquire function of the recursive lock.

detaileddescription.para:
name
recursive lock name
lock_acquire
base lock acquire function
context_sel
either WITHOUT_CONTEXT or WITH_CONTEXT(ctx_type)
The defined acquire function calls lock_acquire of the base lock if the caller thread is not already the owner of the lock. A counter is used to keep track of the number of recursions.
When defined WITHOUT_CONTEXT, the acquire declaration is as follows: voidname##_acquire(name##_t*l,vuint32_tid)
When defined WITH_CONTEXT(ctx_type), the acquire declaration is as follows: voidname##_acquire(name##_t*l,vuint32_tid,ctx_type*ctx)

parameterdescription.para: thread ID or core ID of the caller

briefdescription.para: Defines the release function of the recursive lock.

detaileddescription.para:
name
recursive lock name
lock_release
base lock release function
context_sel
either WITHOUT_CONTEXT or WITH_CONTEXT(ctx_type)
The defined release function decreases the recursion counter, calling lock_release of the base lock once the counter is zero.
When defined WITHOUT_CONTEXT, the release declaration is as follows: voidname##_release(name##_t*l)
When defined WITH_CONTEXT(ctx_type), the release declaration is as follows: voidname##_release(name##_t*l,ctx_type*ctx)

briefdescription.para: Defines the tryacquire function of the recursive lock.

detaileddescription.para:
name
recursive lock name
tryacquire_sel
either WITHOUT_TRYACQUIRE or WITH_TRYACQUIRE(lock_tryacquire)
context_sel
either WITHOUT_CONTEXT or WITH_CONTEXT(ctx_type)
WITHOUT_TRYACQUIRE disables the definition of the tryacquire function. Selecting WITH_TRYACQUIRE(lock_tryacquire) defines the tryacquire function, which tries to acquire the recursive lock, calling lock_tryacquire of the base lock. If the caller is already the owner of the lock, the recursion counter is incremented.

When defined WITHOUT_CONTEXT, the tryacquire declaration is as follows: intname##_tryacquire(name##_t*l,vuint32_tid) When defined WITH_CONTEXT(ctx_type), the tryacquire declaration is as follows: intname##_tryacquire(name##_t*l,vuint32_tid,ctx_type*ctx)
l
recursive lock
id
thread ID or core ID of the caller
ctx
context of the caller thread/core
1 if recursive lock was acquired, otherwise 0.
Note: the return values of the tryacquire of the base lock must be the same as described here: 1 for success, 0 for failure.
macros for documentation only Option to disable the definition of a tryacquire function.

briefdescription.para: Option to enable the definition of a tryacquire function, calling the base lock_tryacquire function.
Option to disable the use of context in acquire and release functions.
Option to add a context argument to acquire and release functions.

detaileddescription.para: Recursive embeds libvsync locks, making them recursive (or reentrant). Recursive employs a set of macros, which declare a new recursive lock type and functions to initialize, acquire, and release the lock.
The following example shows how to make a recursive ticketlock. The name of the new lock is rec_ticketlock.

ref.tooltip: Option to disable the use of context in acquire and release functions.

detaileddescription.para: This defines struct rec_ticketlock_s as well as a type rec_ticketlock_t. It also defines _init, _acquire, and _release functions with the rec_ticketlock prefix.
